title: A plugin pipeline with variance
description:
Process documents through a pipeline of steps, where general steps can be reused for specific document types.

```
Invoice INV-7 -> Validate (any document) -> CalculateTax (invoices) -> Archive (any document)
Letter L-3    -> Validate -> Archive
4 steps run, 0 failed
```
hints: Because of `in T`, an `IStep<Document>` can be added to a `Pipeline<Invoice>` without any casts (lesson 8.05).
Keep steps in a `List<IStep<T>>`; running them is a loop with `try`/`catch` around each.
requirements: `interface IStep<in T> { void Run(T doc, Context ctx); }`; `Document` is a base record, with `Invoice` and `Letter` deriving from it.
A `Pipeline<T>` that accepts `IStep<T>` and therefore also `IStep<Document>` steps.
Steps report into a shared `Context` (a log and a list of errors); one failing step marks the document failed but the pipeline reports it clearly.
stretch: Load the steps for each document type from a configuration list of type names with reflection (milestone 7).
